project.name: ddot.it IntelliJ Plugin
project.description: Authoring support for ddot.it — a minimal notation for knowledge graphs.

target.fail: The canonical ddot.it Rouge lexer was not found at ${ddot.rouge-lexer.file} It is copied into the plugin resources at build time, so the build cannot continue without it. Clone the sibling repository next to this one: git clone git@github.com:Calpano/ddot.it-syntax-tools.git or point an existing checkout at the build: mvn package -Dddot.syntax-tools.dir=/abs/path/to/ddot.it-syntax-tools
